title: The Necklace
synopsis: A story about a beautiful woman who believes she deserves better.

fullText.simplified:
晚宴当天，贾聪甚至比很多女明星都漂亮、时尚。她站在红毯上尽兴地微笑着，接受着人们的崇拜，仿佛她本就是为红毯而生的。
    记者们以为她是新出道的明星，到处打听她的名字，或者想尽办法认识她，但没有一个人知道她是从哪儿来的。
　贾聪对自己的美貌感到自豪，她想：这才是我应得的生活。
　
    晚宴一直持续到很晚。
    在晚宴散场以前，贾聪偷偷地离开了酒店，和丈夫一起回家了。因为她就像灰姑娘，十二点一到，就得拿着鞋子离开，不然就会变回原来的自己：那个住在贷款买的公寓里，开着最普通的车，连买名牌服装都需要犹豫很久的无名美女。
    她不想让记者拍到她卑微的样子，如果这是一场梦，她不想醒来……
    新年的夜里，所有的人都在广场上、路边等待着新年的钟声，许下新年愿望。
    贾聪走在人流中，想着刚才晚宴上珠光宝气的大明星们，觉得眼前的这些人们是那么的卑微。她一边走着一边笑着，等待着美好的明天。仿佛从明天开始，她就会过上每天拍广告、走红毯的新生活。
    看着妻子满足的模样，徐来也觉得很高兴。他们终于走过了人流车流，找到了出租车，打车回了家。
　到家以后，已经是后半夜了，整个公寓寂静无声。
    贾聪忽然开始觉得有些伤心，这场宴会仿佛是一场梦，她不忍心让梦马上醒来。她站在镜子前，看着美丽的自己。她觉得这公寓太普通了，和自己的美貌格格不入。
    她就这么站在镜子前，看着自己……忽然，她一声尖叫！
    徐来跑来问道：“怎么了？”
　贾聪着急地说：“甄……甄美借给我的钻石项链，不……不见了！”
　徐来呆住了：“不可能！这怎么可能呢？”
　于是，他俩开始不停地找项链。晚宴的衣服、包，甚至鞋子都找遍了，结果却一无所得。
    他们开始回想在哪儿丢的项链。然而，贾聪却只记得离开晚宴的时候项链还在，至于是什么时候不见的，她竟然一点儿都想不起来了。
    徐来站在原地发了一会儿呆，然后穿上衣服，他决定把去酒店的路重走一遍，看看能不能找到项链。
    庆祝新年的人们已经回家了，马路上空无一人，寂静无声。徐来一个人走着，广场上除了新年烟花的灰烬，什么都没有。
fullText.traditional:
晚宴當天，賈聰甚至比很多女明星都漂亮、時尚。她站在紅毯上盡興地微笑著，接受著人們的崇拜，彷彿她本就是為紅毯而生的。
    記者們以為她是新出道的明星，到處打聽她的名字，或者想盡辦法認識她，但沒有一個人知道她是從哪兒來的。
　賈聰對自己的美貌感到自豪，她想：這才是我應得的生活。
　
    晚宴一直持續到很晚。
    在晚宴散場以前，賈聰偷偷地離開了酒店，和丈夫一起回家了。因為她就像灰姑娘，十二點一到，就得拿著鞋子離開，不然就會變回原來的自己：那個住在貸款買的公寓裡，開著最普通的車，連買名牌服裝都需要猶豫很久的無名美女。
    她不想讓記者拍到她卑微的樣子，如果這是一場夢，她不想醒來……
    新年的夜裡，所有的人都在廣場上、路邊等待著新年的鐘聲，許下新年願望。
    賈聰走在人流中，想著剛才晚宴上珠光寶氣的大明星們，覺得眼前的這些人們是那麼的卑微。她一邊走著一邊笑著，等待著美好的明天。彷彿從明天開始，她就會過上每天拍廣告、走紅毯的新生活。
    看著妻子滿足的模樣，徐来也覺得很高興。他們終於走過了人流車流，找到了出租車，打車回了家。
　到家以後，已經是後半夜了，整個公寓寂靜無聲。
    賈聰忽然開始覺得有些傷心，這場宴會彷彿是一場夢，她不忍心讓夢馬上醒來。她站在鏡子前，看著美麗的自己。她覺得這公寓太普通了，和自己的美貌格格不入。
    她就這麼站在鏡子前，看著自己……忽然，她一聲尖叫！
    徐来跑來問道：“怎麼了？”
　賈聰著急地說：“甄……甄美借給我的鑽石項鏈，不……不見了！”
　徐来呆住了：“不可能！這怎麼可能呢？”
　於是，他倆開始不停地找項鏈。晚宴的衣服、包，甚至鞋子都找遍了，結果卻一無所得。
    他們開始回想在哪兒丟的項鏈。然而，賈聰卻只記得離開晚宴的時候項鏈還在，至於是什麼時候不見的，她竟然一點兒都想不起來了。
    徐来站在原地發了一會兒呆，然後穿上衣服，他決定把去酒店的路重走一遍，看看能不能找到項鏈。
    慶祝新年的人們已經回家了，馬路上空無一人，寂靜無聲。徐来一個人走著，廣場上除了新年煙花的灰燼，什麼都沒有。

sentences.simplified: 他决定把去酒店的路重走一遍，看看能不能找到项链。
sentences.traditional: 他決定把去酒店的路重走一遍，看看能不能找到項鏈。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué dìng bǎ qù jiǔ diàn de lù chóng zǒu yí biàn kàn kan néng bù néng zhǎo dào xiàng liàn
sentences.english: He decided to retrace their steps to the hotel to see if he could find the necklace.

sentences.simplified: 庆祝新年的人们已经回家了，马路上空无一人，寂静无声。
sentences.traditional: 慶祝新年的人們已經回家了，馬路上空無一人，寂靜無聲。
sentences.pinyin: qìng zhù xīn nián de rén men yǐ jīng huí jiā le mǎ lù shang kōng wú yī rén jì jìng wú shēng
sentences.english: The people celebrating the new year had already gone home. The streets were empty and silent, not a soul in sight.

sentences.simplified: 徐来一个人走着，广场上除了新年烟花的灰烬，什么都没有。
sentences.traditional: 徐来一個人走著，廣場上除了新年煙花的灰燼，什麼都沒有。
sentences.pinyin: xú lái yí ge rén zǒu zhe guǎng chǎng shang chú le xīn nián yān huā de huī jìn shén me dōu méi yǒu
sentences.english: Xu Lai walked alone. On the square, beside the ashes leftover from the new year’s fireworks, there was nothing there.

sentence_translations: On the day of the gala, Jia Cong was even more beautiful and more stylish than many of the female celebrities.
She stood on the red carpet, smiling happily and enjoying the admiration of others.
It was as if she was born for the red carpet.
The reporters thought she was a recently debuted celebrity.
They were asking everywhere trying to find out her name, trying to find a way to get to know her.
But, no one knew where she came from.
Jia Cong was very proud of her good looks. She thought, this is the life that I deserve.
The gala continued quite late into the night.
Before the gala ended, Jia Cong secretly left the hotel and went home with her husband.
This was because she was like Cinderella.
Once midnight struck, she had to grab her shoes and leave, or else she’d turn back into her old self:
The no-name beauty who lived in an apartment bought with a loan, who drove the most ordinary car, ..
.. and even had to hesitate for a long time before buying name brand clothing.
She didn’t want the reporters to capture her lowly side. If this was a dream, she didn’t want to wake up…
The night of the new year, everyone was out on the square or at the side of the road awaiting the new year’s bells, ..
.. making their new year’s wishes.
Jia Cong walked among the crowd, thinking about the big-name celebrities in their splendid jewelry at the gala.
How lowly were the people in front of her eyes, she thought.
She smiled as while she walked, anticipating a beautiful tomorrow.
It was as if starting from tomorrow, she would live a new life of shooting ads and walking red carpets every day.
Seeing how satisfied his wife was, Xu Lai was also very happy.
They finally walked through the crowd of people and cars, found a taxi, and went home.
After returning home, it was already past midnight. The entire apartment building was still and quiet.
Jia Cong suddenly began to feel sad.
It was as if the gala was a dream, and she couldn’t bear to have the dream suddenly end.
She stood in front of the mirror, looking at her gorgeous self.
She felt that this apartment was too ordinary and completely out of place when compared to her beauty.
She was standing in front of the mirror just like that, looking at herself … suddenly, she screamed!
Xu Lai ran over, asking, “What happened?”
Jia Cong said anxiously, “Zhen … Zhen Mei, the diamond necklace that she lent me is … is gone!”
Xu Lai froze, “That can’t be! How could that have happened?”
Hence, they began to incessantly search for the necklace.
They thoroughly searched the clothes, the bag, even the shoes from the gala, but to no avail.
They began to try and recall where they had lost the necklace.
Yet Jia Cong only remembered that the necklace was still there when they left the gala.
As for when it disappeared, she had absolutely no clue.
Xu Lai stood in the same place and stared into the distance for a while, then put on his jacket.
He decided to retrace their steps to the hotel to see if he could find the necklace.
The people celebrating the new year had already gone home. The streets were empty and silent, not a soul in sight.
Xu Lai walked alone. On the square, beside the ashes leftover from the new year’s fireworks, there was nothing there.
